positions.title: Market Risk Analyst
positions.description:
Allocated market risk limits at enterprise and regional levels for Risk Appetite Statements.

Provided projection scenarios for the economic capital model using principal components analysis and
bootstrapping.

Examined the economic impact of derivatives positions with different investment strategies and market
scenarios.

Estimated the change in interest rate risk limits under various yield curve shifts.

Automated weekly reports for derivatives pro t and loss and market summary containing key 
information.

positions.title: Actuarial Associate
positions.description: Legal entities coordination and opinions. Currently working with various valuation units and asset modeling groups for cash flow testing, loss recognition testing, and asset adequacy testing as well as consolidating all the results for various legal filings including the New York Special Considerations, CA RAAIS, and the actuarial memorandum and opinion for each legal entity of MetLife.

positions.title: Actuarial Intern
positions.description: GVWB valuations unit. Ran cash flow testing runs for certain LTC and LTD products.

positions.title: Actuarial Intern
positions.description: Involved in roll out of new compensations calculations software. Tasked with developing certain parts of the compensation calculation and SSO integration within the software environment.

positions.title: Lab Assistant
positions.description:
Worked closely with a doctoral student in organic synthesis. Synthesized and
purified various compounds, and prepared samples for HNMR, ESI,
MALDI-TOF, HPLC and other lab instruments.
